provenance.label_source: Repository-authored synthetic relevance labels, not independent human judgments or hiring outcomes. Existing heldout labels and baseline metrics were previously published; this is reused heldout evaluation, not a new blind test.

fit_config.objective: query-normalized pairwise logistic loss plus L2/2 * squared weight norm
fit_config.tie_break: ascending within-query candidate id; ids are never features

model.score_semantics: Uncalibrated ordering score; neither application eligibility nor hiring probability.

slices.demographic: Not measurable. No demographic annotations or representative populations; these job-related slices do not establish demographic fairness.

domain_cluster_bootstrap_95.note: Descriptive percentile bootstrap on ten synthetic domains; not independent real-world uncertainty.

error_analysis.count_unit: queries with at least one such ordering; labels define direct=3, adjacent=2, generic=1, irrelevant/absent stack=0

timing.source: Local Node wall clock; cached scalar features only, excluding vector generation, source fetching, Worker CPU and cold startup

cost.upstream_vectors: Previously generated local CPU BGE outputs; reused with pinned model/revision/input hashes. Fresh inference cost is not remeasured.

decision.reason: Predeclared numerical adoption gates fail; independent real relevance validation is also absent. Keep the production hybrid unchanged.

limitations: Only 48 repository-authored synthetic queries, with 28 development/20 reused-heldout and five candidates each. Effective heldout units are ten primary domains.
The published heldout is excluded from fitting/tuning, but is not a newly blind benchmark. This is not hiring-outcome evidence.
First-sentence/exact-input embargo removes literal job reuse; template structure, general skills and some domain concepts still cross the dataset. No claim of semantic independence.
The embargo removes every generic grade-1 training row. The resulting incomplete grade coverage weakens generalization; heldout candidates and labels remain unchanged.
Pairwise labels and domains are synthetic and narrow; no applicant demographic fairness or Indian employment-market validity is established.

No reranking feature vector includes raw candidate identity or a learned embedding-dimension coefficient. Job-related text embeddings can nevertheless retain indirect demographic proxies in real data.
Local cached latency is not Cloudflare CPU, live inference, source throughput or concurrent production capacity.
